about: Every PS2X_* option the game reads, in one place. tools/check_settings.py fails if this list and the code disagree, and writes docs/settings.md from it. An option is an environment variable; the same names work as NAME=value lines in ps2x.ini beside the game (the environment wins).

settings.name: PS2X_ASPECT
settings.help: Widescreen. The 3D view shows more at the sides; menus stay a centred 4:3 layout.

settings.name: PS2X_WINDOW_SIZE
settings.help: The game window's size when it opens.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_UPSCALE
settings.help: Internal resolution, as a multiple of the PS2's. F5 steps through them while playing.

settings.name: PS2X_PROGRESSIVE
settings.help: 1 shows the game's full 480-line frame instead of its 224-line copy for TVs. The biggest gain in detail.

settings.name: PS2X_DRAW_DISTANCE
settings.help: Pushes the fog back in ground missions. Objects can appear suddenly and the level's edge may show.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_RENDERER
settings.help: The graphics API PCSX2's renderer uses.

settings.name: PS2X_GS_BACKEND
settings.help: Older name for PS2X_PCSX2_RENDERER=software. Any other value is ignored.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_SHARPNESS
settings.help: Sharpening and anisotropic filtering: off, normal or strong.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_MOVIE_RENDERER
settings.help: Movies are drawn with PCSX2's software renderer, as its GPU renderers garble them (docs/movie-corruption.md). hardware keeps the GPU renderer.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_OSD
settings.help: 1 starts with PCSX2's own statistics overlay showing. F1 shows and hides it while playing.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_BLENDING
settings.default: the level PCSX2's game database recommends (2)
settings.help: Blending accuracy.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_TEXTURE_FILTER
settings.values: 0 nearest, 1 bilinear always, 2 as the PS2 asks, 3 bilinear except sprites
settings.help: Texture filtering.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_TRILINEAR
settings.values: 0 off, 1 as the PS2 asks, 2 forced
settings.help: Trilinear filtering.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_MIPMAP
settings.help: Mipmapping as the game sets it up, or off. The game uses none.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_DITHERING
settings.help: Dithering.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_HALF_PIXEL
settings.help: Upscaling fix; only matters above 1x.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_ROUND_SPRITE
settings.help: Upscaling fix; only matters above 1x.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_NATIVE_SCALING
settings.help: Upscaling fix; only matters above 1x.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_ALIGN_SPRITE
settings.help: Upscaling fix; only matters above 1x.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_MERGE_SPRITE
settings.help: Upscaling fix; only matters above 1x.

settings.name: PS2X_CONTROLS
settings.default: controls.ini in the game's folder, else built-in bindings
settings.help: The key and controller bindings file. The launcher's Controls tab writes one.

settings.name: PS2X_MEMCARD_DIR
settings.help: Where memory card saves are kept.

settings.name: PS2X_INPUT_RECORD
settings.help: Records pad input to this file.

settings.name: PS2X_INPUT_REPLAY
settings.help: Plays a recording back instead of live input, then hands control back.

settings.name: PS2X_VIF1_THREAD
settings.help: 0 keeps graphics data handling on the game's thread (slower; for comparing).

settings.name: PS2X_CONFIG
settings.help: The settings file to read. Environment only.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_GS_DLL
settings.help: The renderer DLL.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_RESOURCES
settings.help: PCSX2's resources folder.

settings.name: PS2X_PCSX2_LOG
settings.help: Writes PCSX2's log to gs-data\logs\ps2x-gs.log beside the DLL.

settings.name: PS2X_GAME_SERIAL
settings.help: The serial PCSX2 looks up for its per-game fixes.

settings.name: PS2X_AUTOPAD
settings.help: Scripted button presses, counted from the first pad read. 0008 is Start, 4000 is Cross.

settings.name: PS2X_MAX_TICKS
settings.help: Exits after that many frames.

settings.name: PS2X_DUMP_FRAMES_DIR
settings.help: Saves frames as PNGs there.

settings.name: PS2X_DUMP_FRAMES_EVERY
settings.help: Gap between saved frames.

settings.name: PS2X_DUMP_FRAMES_AFTER
settings.help: Time before the first saved frame.

settings.name: PS2X_DUMP_FRAMES_COUNT
settings.help: How many frames to save.

settings.name: PS2X_VU1_NATIVE
settings.help: 0 runs VU1 in the interpreter; verify runs both and logs any difference.

settings.name: PS2X_VU0_NATIVE
settings.help: The same for VU0.

settings.name: PS2X_VU_VERIFY_AFTER
settings.help: When verifying starts.

settings.name: PS2X_VU_STATS
settings.help: Reports VU call counts and cost.

settings.name: PS2X_VIF1_STATS
settings.help: Reports VIF1 worker counts and what the game thread waited for.

settings.name: PS2X_VIF_VERIFY
settings.help: Runs the fast and general UNPACK paths together and compares them.

settings.name: PS2X_VU1_DUMP_DIR
settings.help: Saves each distinct VU1 microcode image the game loads.

settings.name: PS2X_VU0_DUMP_DIR
settings.help: The same for VU0.

settings.name: PS2X_VU1_SNAPSHOT_DIR
settings.help: Saves VU1 state before program runs, for replaying them offline.

settings.name: PS2X_VU1_SNAPSHOT_AT
settings.help: When VU1 snapshots start.

settings.name: PS2X_VU1_SNAPSHOT_COUNT
settings.help: How many VU1 snapshots to save.

settings.name: PS2X_VU0_SNAPSHOT_DIR
settings.help: Saves VU0 state before program runs.

settings.name: PS2X_VU0_SNAPSHOT_AT
settings.help: When VU0 snapshots start.

settings.name: PS2X_GIF_CAPTURE
settings.help: Records the GIF packets sent to the GS (read it with tools/testing/gif_capture.py).

settings.name: PS2X_GIF_CAPTURE_AT
settings.help: When the capture starts.

settings.name: PS2X_GIF_CAPTURE_VSYNCS
settings.help: How many vsyncs to capture.

settings.name: PS2X_AUDIO_DUMP
settings.help: Writes the sound output as raw 48 kHz 16-bit stereo.

settings.name: PS2X_CD_STREAM_LOG
settings.help: Logs disc stream reads.

settings.name: PS2X_TRACE_FN
settings.help: Logs arguments and results of the first 400 calls to those game functions. Slows the game enough to disturb replays.

settings.name: PS2X_TRACE_FN_AFTER
settings.help: When call tracing starts.

settings.name: PS2X_TRACE_FN_FROM
settings.help: Only traces calls made from that address range.

settings.name: PS2X_CALLPROF
settings.help: Counts game function calls by caller and target over that window.

settings.name: PS2X_CALLPROF_ARGS
settings.help: Also logs the arguments of the first 200 calls to that function.

settings.name: PS2X_WATCH
settings.help: Logs which game code writes to those memory ranges.

settings.name: PS2X_WATCH_AFTER
settings.help: When write watching and memory peeking start.

settings.name: PS2X_WATCH_VALUES
settings.help: Logs every write with its value; i, b and j keep only suspicious float values.

settings.name: PS2X_PEEK
settings.help: Prints those memory ranges as floats at intervals.

settings.name: PS2X_PEEK_MS
settings.help: The interval for PS2X_PEEK.

settings.name: PS2X_PEEK_HEX
settings.help: Prints PS2X_PEEK ranges as hex words.
